top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Install emergency lighting that can last at least 1 1/2 hours.
Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
top_deficiency_types.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.
Have properly installed electrical wiring and gas equipment.
Use approved construction type or materials.
Provide properly sized and located linen or trash receptacles.
Ensure necessary information is communicated to the resident, and receiving health care provider at the time of a planned discharge.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Implement gradual dose reductions(GDR) and non-pharmacological interventions, unless contraindicated, prior to initiating or instead of continuing psychotropic medication; and PRN orders for psychotropic medications are only used when the medication is necessary and PRN use is limited.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
